rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for actions or movements done secretly and without attracting attention.

example.english: I made a surreptitious effort to take that document away.
example.traditional: 我偷偷摸摸咁拎走咗嗰份文件。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tau1 tau1 mo1 mo1 gam3 ling1 zau2 zo2 go2 fan6 man4 gin6

rows.note: Use this when the secretive behavior looks suspicious or furtive, especially of a person moving around unnoticed.

example.english: Their surreptitious behavior outside the building made us call the police.
example.traditional: 佢哋成晚喺大廈門口鬼鬼祟祟咁行，我哋即刻報警。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 seng4 maan5 hai2 daai6 haa6 mun4 hau2 gwai2 gwai2 seoi6 seoi6 gam3 haang4 ngo5 dei6 zik1 hak1 bou3 ging2
